title: Regulation 9028 — Regulation on Microgrid Development
authority: Puerto Rico Energy Bureau (Negociado de Energía; formerly Puerto Rico Energy Commission)
citation: PREB Regulation No. 9028 (May 18, 2018); proceeding CEPR-MI-2018-0001
notes: The adopted Regulation 9028 PDF on energia.pr.gov is a scanned image (no text layer). Section-level controlling language is quoted from the Energy Commission's published text of the regulation in CEPR-MI-2018-0001 (quote_source_url). Section numbering and thresholds must be confirmed against the adopted text by an energy-regulatory expert.
